info.title: Sluiceway app, for the command line
info.description: The Sluiceway app for `npx sluiceway` and its agents. Every request carries a personal token, made on the person's own page in the app, in `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; a cookie never works here. A token is for one org, and every answer counts as its person, by the same rules as the app's pages. Stack-level facts only: never a resource name, a property path or a value, but for a stack's preview, which is read from GitHub at the request, handed on and kept nowhere.

get.summary: Who the token is, its org, and until when it works.

401.description: No token, or one that does not work.

403.description: The token's person no longer belongs to the org, or the app left it; or, for a pull request, has no write access to the repo.

404.description: Not the token's org, or nothing there the pages would open.

429.description: The token's rate limit is spent. Retry-After says when.

503.description: GitHub did not say whether the person still belongs to the org; or, for a preview, did not answer or has no Checks permission from the org yet.

token.description: A personal token, made on the person's own page in the app (Tokens), for one org, for 30, 90 or 365 days. It starts sluiceway_.

Error.description: Every answer that is not a success.

problems.description: One sentence per change that was refused.

state.description: The app's five states: queued is deploying, drift is drifted, preview failed is failed.

word.description: The dashboard's own word: queued, preview failed, in sync…

destroys.description: A pending stack that deletes or replaces resources.

line.description: The row's one line of meaning, as the org view says it.

anyOf.description: While the repo's sluiceway.yaml does not name sluiceway[bot] in recordWriters.

page.description: The org's page in the app.

locked.description: The adopted repos past the free allowance: their name and state counts only.

anyOf.description: The repos of the org the token's person cannot read on GitHub, counted; null when they read every one.

page.description: The org's page in the app.

Deploy.description: A deploy, as the audit log says it.

anyOf.description: The deployment record, or null for a deploy made outside the dashboard.

who.description: ticked by alice, merged by bob, or no tick.

anyOf.description: in the app, or via the command line: where the tick was asked.

result.description: In the trail's words: waiting to start, deploying now, went out, failed, no changes, drift fixed, drift gone, rehearsed, destroyed.

state.description: The app's five states: queued is deploying, drift is drifted, preview failed is failed.

anyOf.description: 1 update, 1 replace: the row's counts in its words.
What the row deletes or replaces.
The stack's preview page: the check run of this name on the scanned commit, which the commit's checks list.

destroys.description: How many resources the stack's row deletes or replaces.

anyOf.description: The scanned commit the row was read at.
What a tick of this stack sends back as confirm, or null for a stack that deletes and replaces nothing.

Preview.description: A stack's full preview, read from GitHub at the request and kept nowhere: the one answer that holds resource names, types, property paths and the values dashboard.showValues lists.

page.description: The stack's preview page: the check run its row links.

name.description: sluiceway / <stack id>, the check run's name.

title.description: The page's title: the stack id and its counts.

type.description: The resource type, as the tool names it.

properties.description: Every property path that changes, those that force a replace first.

forcedBy.description: The property paths that force a replace.

values.description: The old and new value, only at a path the repo's dashboard.showValues lists; null where the property is absent on that side.

changes.description: Every change the page lists: deletes, then replaces, then the rest.

drift.description: What changed outside the code, never what it changed to.

unlisted.description: How many changes the page leaves out to stay inside GitHub's limit. The scan's job log lists them.

unread.description: How many lines of the page the app could not read.

asked.description: A rescan asked in the app or through the command line, and a pull request the command line opened.

anyOf.description: The repos of the org the token's person cannot read on GitHub, counted; null when they read every one.

outcome.description: asked: the record is open and GitHub and the runner decide the rest; queued: the record is open and waits behind the stacks this one depends on, or for a deploy window or the end of a deploy freeze, and a later run of resolve starts it; waits: a stack this one depends on has a change waiting that nobody ticked, so nothing was asked; github: the tick happens on the dashboard on GitHub; unconfirmed: the stack deletes or replaces resources and the tick did not confirm it as it stands, so nothing was asked.

destroys.description: How many resources the stack's row deletes or replaces.

anyOf.description: The scanned commit the row was read at.
For an unconfirmed tick: what to send as confirm to deploy the stack.

keys.description: Every key a change may name, with the value the file gives it.

KeyChange.description: A documented key of sluiceway.yaml that edit mode changes: dashboard.title, dashboard.redact, dashboard.sections, drift.enabled, tickers, recordWriters (true names sluiceway[bot]), ignore, stacks[<stack id>].deploy, stacks[<stack id>].tickers, and the rest the config route lists. null puts the action's default back.
